facts.fact: AMS-IX says EG-IX, launched with Telecom Egypt in April 2022 as Egypt's first open access exchange in Cairo, connected 19 networks by Q3 2026.
AMS-IX says EG-IX peak traffic reached 945 Gb/s by Q3 2026, against 338 Gb/s in 2025 and 89 Gb/s in 2023.

EGY.note: No share of the population using the internet.
